mapper.select: SELECT ANY_VALUE ( mur.user_id ) AS id, ANY_VALUE( m.member_name ) AS name, ANY_VALUE ( mr.member_id ) AS member_id, MAX( mr.start_time ) AS start_time, MAX( mr.end_time ) AS end_time FROM team_link l INNER JOIN team_member_rel mr ON l.team_id = mr.team_id INNER JOIN org_member m ON m.id = mr.member_id INNER JOIN org_member_user_rel mur ON mur.member_id = m.id WHERE l.module_id = #{getDTO.moduleId} AND l.data_id = #{getDTO.dataId} GROUP BY mr.member_id
